title: Levitation Wand!
description: Adds a wand that gives you levitation when right clicked!
body:
This is a simple mod that adds a wand that gives you the ability to fly! It is crafted with 2 iron nuggets, 4 shulker shells and 1 nether star which makes it balanced and gives nether stars another use.
![Levitation Wand Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93de7119f548372e76fbf87be1cc601f4e8d9bbd.png)

You can use this mod for challenges, when playing with your friends, or whenever else you want to use it.

Have fun! :)
